title: {{name}} and the Castle Cat
summary: 营救受困小动物(梯子):城堡里主角听到哭声,发现小猫困在高树上,用梯子爬上去把它抱下来成朋友。
text:
{{name}} lived in a big castle. {{name}} was a kind child. One day, {{name}} heard a sad sound. It came from the garden. {{name}} ran to look. A little cat sat in a tall tree. The cat was scared. It could not get down.

"Do not be scared," said {{name}}. "I will help you."

{{name}} looked up at the cat. The tree was very high. {{name}} did not stop. {{name}} was brave because the cat needed help. First, {{name}} got a long ladder. Then {{name}} put it on the tree. {{name}} went up, step by step.

The cat looked at {{name}}. It was still scared. But {{name}} smiled at it. "Come to me," {{name}} said softly. The cat walked to {{name}}. {{name}} held it close and safe.

{{name}} went down the ladder. The cat was happy now. It was not scared. {{name}} gave it some warm milk. The cat played in the garden all day. They were good friends. {{name}} felt very happy because {{name}} helped a new friend.

questions.prompt: What did {{name}} use to help the cat?
How did {{name}} feel at the end?
